The '''Daan''' were a faction of people on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]]. Governed by the [[Daan Council]], they were at war with the [[Melida/Legends|Melida]] until [[The Young]] ended the [[Melida/Daan Civil War]]. The Melida saw the Daan as feral beasts and used perceived wrongdoings to continue the centuries-long war.
